18Gbps HDBaseT receiver for the standard MXV series matrix switchers. The RXV-35-SCL features a powerful scaler that can convert 4K UHD and HDR content to a 1080p non-HDR display to maximize compatibility. The receiver also features stereo and digital S/PDIF audio breakout for easy external audio distribution.

The RXV-35-SCL allows video output to be scaled to match the capabliity of the connected display. Transmit a 4K HDR source to a 4K HDR display and at the same time scale another zone to 1080p without effecting the quality of the source.

The very core of WyreStorm transmission, we’ve embraced HDBaseT technology since 2010. We’re now taking the capabilities of HDBaseT to the next level and supporting video bandwidths in excess of 10Gbps with our lossless compression technology built in to out H2X matrix platform. The RXV-35-SCL will output HDMI content at up to 2160p 4:4:4/60.

salesLanguage.plainEnglishSummary: Use this when the source, display, USB device or control point is too far away for a simple local cable.

salesLanguage.realWorldApplication: Displays away from the rack, lecterns, teaching rooms, meeting rooms and point-to-point signal paths.

talkTrack: It solves a distance problem.
Use it when the video path needs reliable point-to-point extension.
It is usually simpler than AV-over-IP when the path is one source to one display.
